messages:
viv: Quick sync 1: SEO sprint for the launch funnel — landing + 3 posts + webinar. Need: keyword intent split, minimal JSON-LD per asset, internal-link priority list, and an emergency redirect rollback plan.
sam: I'll run KW intent audits. Plan: pick 1 brand+1 high-intent + 2 longtail per page. Will share CSV.
rachel: Ill handle schema & breadcrumbs for posts and webinar. Keep it tiny so SSR pages don't bloat.
leo: I can map anchors and CTAs for internal linking. Prioritize hero -> signup, post -> benchmark snippets -> landing.
seo-bot: Reminder: capture baseline sessions & avg CTR for the main keyword 7 days pre-launch. Tag dataset with launch_id=LF-2025. :spiral_calendar:
viv: Draft KW suggestions (primary | supporting longtails):
- landing: "redwood inference platform" | "production llm serving", "low-latency model serving"
- webinar: "llm serving best practices" | "inference cost per token", "batching strategies"
- post1 (bench): "gpu inference throughput" | "p95 latency benchmarks", "throughput per GPU"
- post2 (savings): "inference cost optimization" | "quantization for inference", "kv-cache benefits"
- post3 (ops): "model rollout best practices" | "canary deployments for models", "fallback routing for inference"
sam: Good. I'll check search volume and intent and return with top 3 per asset by EOD tomorrow.
rachel: Schema plan: Event schema for webinar, Article schema for blog posts, BreadcrumbList for the series, and Organization meta on landing. Example (webinar minimal):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Demo","startDate":"2025-06-03T18:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.inference/events/launch-demo","description":"Live demo + benchmarks for production LLM inference."}
```
leo: Internal link priorities (quick):
1) Landing hero -> Webinar registration (primary CTA)
2) Landing -> Post1 (bench highlights card)
3) Post1 -> Landing (CTA: try the demo) + Post2 & Post3 inline links
4) Webinar page -> Resource anchors (slides, benchmarks, code repo)
5) Add contextual anchor text: "p95 latency" linking to bench post, "inference cost" linking to savings post
viv: Redirect & rollback play: use 301 for canonical moves, 302/307 for experiments. Always deploy staging redirects first. Example Nginx rules: 
```
# permanent move
rewrite ^/old-llm-launch/?$ /launch/redwood-inference permanent;
# experiment variant (temporary)
location = /launch/test-variant { return 302 /launch/redwood-inference; }
```
ops-bot: Ops checklist: deploy redirects to staging -> run smoke curl tests -> verify Location header and canonical link.
leo: Smoke test commands: `curl -I -L https://redwood.inference/old-llm-launch` then check for 301 and final URL. Also check <link rel=\"canonical\"> in HTML.
viv: Microcopy CTAs: short variants to A/B test: "See live benchmarks", "Register for demo", "Try Redwood free". Use UTM template: `?utm_source=launch_email&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=launch1&utm_content={cta}`
sam: I'll add KW rows to /docs/seo/launch_kw_candidates.csv and flag intent (informational / commercial / navigational).
rachel: For Article schema include author, datePublished, mainEntityOfPage, headline. BreadcrumbList should show: Home > Resources > Launch > Post title.
ops-bot: Note: if slugs change during last-minute edits, add 301s and keep a rollback script: `bin/rollback_redirects.sh` to remove new rules and re-enable old ones. Test with `curl -svI`.
seo-bot: Benchmark metric note: capture median and p95 latency, tokens per second, and cost per 1k tokens. Store in benchmark narrative with experiment tags.
viv: Action items
- sam: full KW intent + CSV by tomorrow EOD
- rachel: publish JSON-LD snippets + breadcrumb template by Tue noon
- leo: internal link anchor map + CTA variants by Wed morning
- ops-bot/leo: staging redirect deploy + smoke tests Wed afternoon
- viv: update launch playbook and add redirect map to PR
Thanks everyone 680 Keep comments short in this thread for auditability.
